title: Mystery Collectible Cards and Manifesto
whatItIs: A mobile page section titled 'SERIES_01 COLLECTIBLES' with a unit tag and status text, three tilted white cards showing a circled question mark with circular text, a fourth pink limited card, then a giant 'WHY IT EXISTS.' heading beside a vertical rule and three numbered points with pink, lime and blue squares.
whatItMeans: Sealed mystery cards create curiosity, and coloured square bullets tie the manifesto to the palette.

One pink card as the rare item
Heavy heading beside a thick vertical rule
Coloured square markers for list items

vocabulary.definition: A ring of text around a central symbol.
A short numbered statement of purpose.
A thick line separating a heading from its content.
